rules.title: Prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing (algorithmic devices)
rules.requirement: In San Diego, a landlord may not use rent-setting software that uses nonpublic data from two or more landlords to set rents or occupancy levels, and no one may sell or license such software to landlords. A tenant can sue for an injunction, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees if the tenant wins.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 civil penalty per violation; each month and each property is a separate violation

coverage.summary: All residential rental property in the City of San Diego. The ban covers the sale or licensing of algorithmic devices and any landlord's use of them to set rents or occupancy levels.

rules.exemptions: Not an algorithmic device: (a) software that publishes reports from aggregated historical nonpublic data more than 90 days old, or from public information, and does not recommend future rents or occupancy; (b) software used to set rents or income limits under local, state or federal affordable housing program guidelines; (c) appraisal software that does not recommend rental rates during runtime.
rules.penalty: Tenant civil action for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with costs and reasonable attorney's fees to the prevailing party. Each month a use violation continues, and each property involved, is a separate violation. The City may also enforce under Chapter 1, Article 2, including civil and criminal remedies.
rules.citation: San Diego Mun. Code § 98.1103 (O-21955 N.S.; see also §§ 98.1102, 98.1104)
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.

notes: The official adopted text supersedes the 2025 proposal (D076). The sale ban (§98.1103(a)) and the use ban (§98.1103(b)) are combined in one record. Remedies come from §98.1104. The document does not discuss interaction with state law on rent-setting algorithms.
